Guild Overview

This posse is just a few weeks old and has grown crazy. I started it for 2 reasons #1 MCW my old posse was getting too many requests from people only interested in joining for PLVLing. and #2 I needed to do something to keep my interest in the game. Since I've started this posse, alot of good people have joined and the posse is made of low levels for the most part and is comming into it's own. Everyone please keep an eye on the message of the day as there we list the people who are not welcome in the posse. I'm easy going but if the only reason you've joined the posse is for PLVLing or for free gear, please don't waste our time. That being said, if you're looking for something, feel free to ask, if we have extra we're not using, we'll give it to you, if we don't, kill kill kill and eventually you'll find something you can use. LOL I'm glad I started this posse, and look forward to getting to know yous in the future. Thanks.---Big

Latest News

Welcome all new members. If anyone harrasses you, let one of the lvl 8 officers or me know and we'll handle it. Thanks and have fun.

All members feel free to use this part of the page if you want or need to tell the crue any ideas, bitches,gripes or complaints you may have. Just put your online name next to it so I can talk to you about it. Thanks.---Big
